CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Biblical Stewardship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Biblical Stewardship.
   B. Apply the teaching of Biblical Stewardship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Biblical Stewardship has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Biblical Stewardship to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Study Methods Devotional Method? (1 mark)
